title: Fuzzy Canary: Poor-man's solution to stopping AI companies from scraping your blog  #github
description:
AI companies are scraping everyone’s blogs for training data — and if you’re self-hosting, you basically have… no defense. That’s where Fuzzy Canary comes in. It’s a poor-man’s anti-scraping trick that plants invisible links in your HTML — links that trigger AI companies’ content safety filters.

https://github.com/vivienhenz24/fuzzy-canary

#github #opensource
